name: SAP SuccessFactors HXM Suite
certifications: SAP Certified Associate - Implementation Consultant - SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Core
SAP Certified Associate - SAP SuccessFactors Performance and Goals
SAP Certified Associate - SAP SuccessFactors Compensation
SAP Certified Associate - SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting
SAP Certified Associate - SAP SuccessFactors Onboarding
SAP Certified Associate - SAP SuccessFactors Learning
tools: SAP SuccessFactors demo or training instance

beginner.summary: For HR professionals, HR IT staff and new SuccessFactors consultants. Covers the HXM suite and instance basics, navigation, Admin Center, role-based permissions, foundation objects and MDF, the Employee Central data model, hiring and job changes, position management, workflows, business rules, Time Off, Goal and Performance Management, Recruiting, Onboarding, Learning, story reports and data imports.
prerequisites: Understands HR processes such as hiring, job changes, leave and performance reviews
outcomes: Navigate and administer a SuccessFactors instance
Configure Employee Central basics: foundation data, permissions, workflows and rules
Run talent processes in Performance and Goals, Recruiting, Onboarding and Learning
Report on HR data and load data with import templates

days.topic: SAP SuccessFactors Overview, HXM Suite and Instance Setup
subtopics: What SAP SuccessFactors is and where it fits with SAP S/4HANA and SAP HCM
The HXM suite: Employee Central, talent, learning, payroll and analytics
Cloud release cycle: two major releases a year
Demo and training instances for practice
Logging in and the home page
User roles: employee, manager, HR and administrator
Implementation partners and SAP Activate in brief
Course case company: a 3,000-person manufacturer in India and Germany
days.lab_task: Log in as an employee, a manager, an HR administrator and a system administrator, list what each can see and do, and map the course case company's HR processes to SuccessFactors modules.
days.deliverable: Role comparison and process-to-module map
checks: Differences in menus and tiles recorded
Each HR process linked to the right module
Preview and production timing described correctly

days.topic: Navigation, Home Page and People Profile
subtopics: Home page cards and quick actions
days.lab_task: Find an employee with action search, review their People Profile, follow the org chart to their manager, complete a To-Do item and act as a proxy for another user.
days.deliverable: Navigation checklist with screenshots
objectives: Use People Profile and org chart

days.topic: Admin Center, Provisioning and Instance Settings
subtopics: Provisioning and who has access to it
days.lab_task: Change company settings and languages, create a picklist, edit an email notification template, review the Upgrade Center and run the Check Tool to find and fix one issue.
days.deliverable: Configuration changes and Check Tool results
checks: New text received by a test user

days.lab_task: Create roles for employee self-service, managers and HR business partners in India, grant them to dynamic groups with target populations and test with proxy.
days.deliverable: Permission roles, groups and test results
checks: View salary as an employee for someone else
Roles and groups listed for a user

days.topic: Organisation Objects and the Metadata Framework
subtopics: Foundation objects: legal entity, business unit, division, department, location
days.lab_task: Create legal entities for India and Germany with business units, departments, locations and job classifications, link them with associations and import 50 cost centres.
days.deliverable: Foundation data and import log
checks: Pick a department in a job record
Only departments for the chosen division shown
Change a department name effective next month

subtopics: Field labels, visibility and required settings
Country-specific fields for India and Germany
days.lab_task: Review the data models, add a custom field to Job Information, make a field required for Germany only and add India-specific fields for PAN and Aadhaar with correct visibility.
days.deliverable: Data model changes and screenshots
checks: Hire in Germany without the required field
Sensitive IDs visible only to HR

days.topic: Hiring Employees and Managing Job Changes
subtopics: Job changes: promotion, transfer and pay change
days.lab_task: Hire three employees with a hire template, promote one with a pay change, transfer one to Germany and terminate and rehire one, recording event reasons each time.
days.deliverable: Employee records and history
checks: New job and pay records with the right event reason
New legal entity and country fields

days.lab_task: Create positions for a new department, sync job data from positions, hire into a vacant position and view the position org chart.
days.deliverable: Positions, hire record and org chart screenshot
checks: Job data filled from the position
Incumbent's job data updated by sync rules
Vacant positions shown in the org chart

subtopics: Approvers: managers, roles and dynamic groups
tools: Manage Organisation, Pay and Job Structures
days.lab_task: Create a promotion workflow approved by the manager's manager and HR, with HR CC'd, delegate approval during leave and escalate requests pending for five days.
days.deliverable: Workflow configuration and test records
checks: Approvals routed in the right order

subtopics: Rule syntax: If, Then and Else
days.lab_task: Write rules that default the probation end date, validate notice periods by country, derive event reasons for pay changes and trigger the promotion workflow.
days.deliverable: Rules and test results
checks: Event reason derived and workflow triggered

subtopics: Country rules for India and Germany
days.lab_task: Configure annual leave with monthly accruals, sick leave and public holidays for India and Germany, request leave as an employee, approve it and run period-end processing.
days.deliverable: Time Off configuration and test results

days.lab_task: Configure a goal plan with weights, cascade a company goal to two teams, create goals from the library and update progress as employees.
days.deliverable: Goal plan configuration and goal records

days.lab_task: Build a performance form with goals and competencies, a route map with self and manager assessment, launch it for a team and complete one review end to end.
days.deliverable: Form template, route map and completed review
checks: Form moves to the manager step

days.lab_task: Create a requisition template, open a requisition from a vacant position, route it for approval and attach a job profile.
days.deliverable: Template, requisition and approval history
checks: Job details filled from the position

days.lab_task: Post the job, apply as two candidates, move them through the status pipeline, schedule an interview, approve an offer and send the hire to Onboarding.
days.deliverable: Candidate records, interview and offer

days.lab_task: Configure onboarding tasks for IT, facilities and the manager, assign a buddy, collect new hire documents and complete the hire into Employee Central.
days.deliverable: Onboarding configuration and completed process
checks: IT and facilities receive their tasks

days.topic: SuccessFactors Learning: Items, Assignments and Curricula
days.lab_task: Create a safety item and a curriculum, assign them to new hires with an assignment profile, complete a course as an employee and report overdue training.
days.deliverable: Learning items, assignment profile and report

days.topic: Reporting with Story Reports and People Analytics
days.lab_task: Build story reports for headcount by department, hires and leavers by month and pending leave, share them with HR business partners and schedule a weekly email.
days.deliverable: Story reports and schedule

days.topic: Importing Employee Data with Import Templates
subtopics: Templates for basic and extended data
days.lab_task: Load 200 employees from a legacy file in the right order (basic data, personal, employment, job and compensation), fix import errors and run an incremental update.
days.deliverable: Import files, job results and error fixes

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: HR Processes for the Case Company
days.lab_task: Configure foundation data, permissions, a hire-to-retire flow with workflows and rules, Time Off, a goal and review cycle and recruiting through onboarding for the case company, then demo it with reports.
days.deliverable: Configuration workbook, test records, reports and demo recording
checks: Hire a candidate end to end
Requisition to Employee Central record completed
Each role sees only what it should
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one solution
Run core HR and talent processes

intermediate.summary: For SuccessFactors consultants and HRIS analysts. Covers advanced Employee Central data models, MDF objects and UIs, advanced business rules, Employee Central Payroll and Payroll Control Center, Time Tracking, Compensation, Variable Pay, Succession and Career Development, advanced Recruiting, Recruiting Marketing, advanced Onboarding and Learning, Integration Center, OData APIs and Integration Suite, data protection and privacy, release management, advanced People Analytics and certification preparation.
prerequisites: Configures Employee Central foundation data, permissions, workflows and rules
Has run talent processes in SuccessFactors
Understands HR processes in at least one country
outcomes: Design advanced Employee Central configurations with MDF and rules
Configure payroll, time, compensation and succession processes
Integrate SuccessFactors through Integration Center, OData and Integration Suite
Manage privacy, releases and certification readiness

days.topic: Employee Central Data Model Configuration in Depth
subtopics: XML data models and when they are still used
days.lab_task: Configure dependent picklists, a global assignment from India to Germany, concurrent employment for a second job and contingent workers with their own fields, under change control.
days.deliverable: Configuration changes, change log and test records
checks: Pick a country then a state
State list depends on the country
Separate worker type with its fields

days.topic: MDF Objects, Rules and Custom UIs
days.lab_task: Build a custom MDF object for company assets with relationships to employees, rules, permissions, a custom UI and an approval workflow, and import 100 assets.
days.deliverable: Object definition, UI, rules and imported data
checks: Linked to the employee with approval

days.lab_task: Write a cross-entity rule that updates compensation when job grade changes, a lookup rule for location allowances, an alert for contracts ending soon and trace a rule that misfires.
days.deliverable: Rules, test results and trace analysis
checks: Pay updated by the cross-entity rule

days.topic: Employee Central Payroll and Payroll Control Center
subtopics: Replication from Employee Central to payroll
days.lab_task: Replicate employees to Employee Central Payroll, run a payroll simulation, resolve Payroll Control Center alerts and process an off-cycle payment.
days.deliverable: Replication log, simulation results and alert resolutions
checks: Employee in payroll with correct data

subtopics: Time Tracking compared with Time Off
days.lab_task: Configure time sheets with overtime rules for Germany, record a week with overtime, approve it and pass the valuated time to payroll.
days.deliverable: Time configuration and test week
checks: Overtime calculated by the valuation rules

days.lab_task: Configure a merit plan with eligibility, guidelines by rating and budgets, run worksheets for two managers, approve them and publish results to Employee Central.
days.deliverable: Template, worksheets and published records

days.lab_task: Configure a bonus plan using business results and individual ratings, import history, run worksheets and generate bonus statements.
days.deliverable: Plan configuration, worksheets and statements

days.lab_task: Nominate successors for three key roles, set readiness, build a talent pool, run a calibration session with a nine-box grid and report succession gaps.
days.deliverable: Nominations, calibration results and gap report
checks: Successors and readiness shown on the org chart

days.lab_task: Configure development plans and a career worksheet, run a role readiness assessment, link learning to a development goal and set up a mentoring programme.
days.deliverable: Configuration and test records
checks: Gaps against the target role shown
Course appears in the development plan

days.lab_task: Redesign status sets for graduate and experienced hiring, configure interview scheduling with Outlook, build offer letter templates and set recruiting permissions by stage.
days.deliverable: Templates, status sets and test candidates
checks: View a candidate as a hiring manager

days.topic: Recruiting Marketing and Career Site Builder
days.lab_task: Build a branded career site with search, job alerts and a talent community, distribute jobs to two job boards and report applicants by source.
days.deliverable: Career site and source report
checks: Alert email for a new job

days.topic: Onboarding in Depth: Programmes, Compliance and Offboarding
days.lab_task: Configure country-specific onboarding variants, a document flow with e-signature, crossboarding for a transfer and offboarding with IT access removal tasks.
days.deliverable: Process variants, documents and test records

days.lab_task: Import SCORM content, schedule an instructor-led class with registration approval, run assignment profiles for 1,000 employees and report compliance by department.
days.deliverable: Content, class, profiles and report

days.lab_task: Build an outbound integration that sends new hires to a third-party benefits provider over SFTP daily, with filters and calculated fields, and an inbound integration for bank details.
days.deliverable: Integration definitions and run logs
checks: File delivered with new hires only

days.topic: OData APIs and SAP Integration Suite
days.lab_task: Query employees through OData with OAuth, upsert a job change, deploy a prepackaged Integration Suite flow and monitor a failed message.
days.deliverable: API collection, flow deployment and monitoring notes
checks: Error found in Integration Suite monitoring

subtopics: Country rules: GDPR and India's DPDP Act
days.lab_task: Configure retention times for terminated employees, run a purge request, turn on read audit for sensitive fields and produce a data subject information report.
days.deliverable: Retention settings, purge results and audit reports
checks: Personal data listed for the employee

days.lab_task: Review the upcoming release notes, plan testing for affected processes, move configuration from test to production with Instance Synchronisation and run a regression test.
days.deliverable: Release plan, sync log and regression results

subtopics: Story reports with multiple data sources
Embedding reports in the home page
days.lab_task: Build an attrition and diversity story with calculated metrics, restrict it by role, add it to the home page and tune a slow report.
days.deliverable: Story reports and settings
checks: HR partners see only their population

days.lab_task: Take a timed practice exam for your chosen module, rebuild wrong answers in the instance, practise weak areas and take a second exam.
days.deliverable: Two practice scores and a weak-areas list

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Global Talent and Pay Cycle
days.lab_task: For the case company, configure an annual cycle: goals and reviews, calibration, merit and bonus planning published to Employee Central and payroll, succession nominations, an external benefits integration and analytics, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Configuration workbook, test records, integration logs and demo recording
checks: Run the cycle end to end
Ratings drive pay changes published to payroll
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one cycle

advanced.summary: For SuccessFactors solution architects and programme leads. Covers HXM solution architecture, global Employee Central design, integration with SAP S/4HANA and payroll, BTP extensions, AI with Joule, talent intelligence, workforce planning, data migration, testing, identity and security, compliance and works councils, performance at scale, change management, landscape governance, HR service delivery, global payroll integration, HR process transformation, production troubleshooting and programme leadership.
prerequisites: Has configured several SuccessFactors modules in projects
Understands integrations through Integration Center or Integration Suite
Has worked with HR stakeholders in more than one country
outcomes: Design global SuccessFactors solutions and integration architectures
Extend the suite with BTP and AI features
Lead data migration, testing, security and compliance
Run implementations and support with strong governance

days.topic: HXM Solution Architecture and Implementation Approach
days.lab_task: Run a fit-to-standard workshop for hire-to-retire, produce a solution design with core and local parts for three countries and record key decisions.
days.deliverable: Workshop notes, solution design and decision records
checks: Global and country parts clearly listed
Options and reasons for each decision

days.lab_task: Design a global Employee Central for operations in India, Germany, the US and Singapore: organisation, job architecture, local fields and languages, and review it for unnecessary customisation.
days.deliverable: Global design and review findings
checks: One global structure with local grades mapped

days.topic: Integrating SuccessFactors with SAP S/4HANA and SAP HCM
days.lab_task: Replicate employees and organisation data from Employee Central to S/4HANA, fix a replication error and compare core hybrid and side-by-side models for the case company.
days.deliverable: Replication results, error fix and model comparison

subtopics: When to extend and when to configure
SAP Build Apps and Build Process Automation
days.lab_task: Build an approval app on BTP that reads employee data from SuccessFactors, reacts to a hire event and writes back with the user's permissions.
days.deliverable: Extension app, event set-up and tests

days.topic: AI in SuccessFactors: Joule and AI-Assisted Processes
subtopics: AI-assisted writing in performance and goals
AI in recruiting: job descriptions and matching
Responsible AI and works council concerns
days.lab_task: Enable selected AI features in a test instance, test Joule tasks for managers, review AI-written feedback for bias and write a governance note for rollout.
days.deliverable: Test results, bias review and governance note
checks: Rules for use and review defined

days.topic: Talent Intelligence Hub and Opportunity Marketplace
subtopics: Connecting skills to learning and recruiting
days.lab_task: Load a skills library, let employees add skills, post two gigs in the marketplace, match employees and report internal mobility.
days.deliverable: Skills configuration, gigs and mobility report

days.lab_task: Build a three-year headcount and cost plan with scenarios from Employee Central data in SAP Analytics Cloud and present it to a role-play finance partner.
days.deliverable: Planning model, scenarios and presentation

subtopics: Source analysis from SAP HCM and other systems
days.lab_task: Map data from a legacy HR system, cleanse it, run two mock loads, reconcile counts and pay totals and write the cutover plan.
days.deliverable: Mapping, mock load results, reconciliation and cutover plan
checks: Error rate falls in the second load
Counts and pay totals match the source

subtopics: Test phases: unit, integration, UAT and regression
days.lab_task: Write a test strategy and scenarios for hire-to-retire, automate five regression tests, run them against a release preview and manage defects to sign-off.
days.deliverable: Strategy, scenarios, automated tests and sign-off
checks: Results recorded for the preview release

days.topic: Identity, Single Sign-On and Security Architecture
subtopics: SAP Cloud Identity Services: IAS and IPS
Single sign-on with corporate identity providers
days.lab_task: Set up SSO through IAS with a corporate identity provider, provision users with IPS, review roles for segregation of duties and audit API users.
days.deliverable: Identity configuration, role review and audit
checks: User created with the right groups

days.topic: Compliance, Works Councils and Global Regulations
days.lab_task: Prepare a works council briefing for a Germany rollout, define retention by country, check data residency and assemble audit evidence.
days.deliverable: Briefing pack, retention matrix and evidence
checks: Data use and monitoring explained clearly
Rules per country and data type

days.lab_task: Run mass changes for 10,000 employees, find a slow rule and fix it, review centralised services settings and plan integration volumes for peak periods.
days.deliverable: Mass change results, rule fix and volume plan

subtopics: Resistance and how to address it
days.lab_task: Write a change and training plan for a Performance and Goals rollout, define adoption metrics, run a manager briefing role play and plan follow-up.
days.deliverable: Change plan, metrics and briefing notes

days.lab_task: Design the instance landscape and change process, document configuration owners, detect a drift between test and production and set up a governance board.
days.deliverable: Landscape design, process and drift report

days.topic: HR Service Delivery and Case Management Integration
subtopics: Integration with ServiceNow HR or SAP Service Cloud
tools: ServiceNow HRSD or SAP Service Cloud
days.lab_task: Design HR service delivery for the case company, route HR cases from SuccessFactors to a service tool with employee context and measure response times.
days.deliverable: Service design, integration and metrics

subtopics: Employee Central Payroll and third-party payroll
days.lab_task: Design payroll integration for four countries with different providers, build one third-party interface, reconcile results and handle a cut-off failure.
days.deliverable: Payroll integration design, interface and reconciliation
checks: Provider receives complete data before cut-off

days.lab_task: Map the current promotion process, design a simpler standard process in SuccessFactors, estimate time saved and present a business case.
days.deliverable: Current and future process maps and business case

days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected issues (missing permissions, a stuck workflow, a failing rule, a broken integration and bad imported data), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review

days.topic: Programme Leadership and Application Management Support
days.lab_task: Build a programme plan for a three-country rollout with risks, design the support model after go-live and present a status report to a sponsor.
days.deliverable: Programme plan, risk log, support model and status report
checks: Risks and decisions clear to the sponsor

days.lab_task: Design and partly build a global SuccessFactors transformation for the case company: global EC design, S/4HANA and payroll integration, a BTP extension, data migration with reconciliation, AI governance, testing and a go-live plan, then present it to a steering committee.
days.deliverable: Solution design, integration evidence, migration results, test plan and steering presentation
checks: Hire flows to S/4HANA and payroll
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one programme
